title: fix(service-automation)!: a parent-id resume of a map whose item run is still suspended is refused, naming the item run
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DF7fjxkB5Bbtyuwr1fLzN4Y)_

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxEzAw9N6UiWHC6Zp2

Fixes #27877

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable metadata changes; a resume the engine accepted is refused

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:批量流程停在 `map` 节点、某一项的子运行还挂起时,用父运行 id 续跑现在被拒绝(带错误码),提示改续跑那一项的子运行 id,什么都不推进。
- 为什么改:以前这样续跑会让 `map` 直接跳过那一项:父运行记为完成,那一项根本没跑,它的挂起记录被遗弃。分诊裁定这是静默跳过,必须拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING):以前答成功的父 id 续跑现在被拒。续跑子运行、`subflow` 委派、服务专属节点的 403 都不变。拒绝码暂用 `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS` 占位,是否换新码等分诊答复(卡评论 6514753022)。回滚即还原这一个 commit。
- 先看:`src/run-resume.ts`(`refuseGatedResume` 与新的 `refuseMapItemSkip`)、`src/engine.ts`(`resolveSuspensionChain` 与 `LINKED_RUN_PREFIXES` 文档块)、`src/map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts src/resume-authority-gate.test.ts`,预期 27 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(先等分诊定拒绝码)。

## Measured at the in-process door (`engine.resume`)

A run paused at a `map` node (correlation `map:CHILD`), resumed by the **parent** run id, with the item child parked on a node declaring `resumeAuthority: 'any'`:

| | Before (`origin/main` e41642dd) | After (7edf37b4) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| answer | `success: true`, no code | `success: false`, code `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS` (see *Open question*), message names the item run id: "Resume run 'ITEM' instead" |
| parent run row | `completed` | no terminal row; parent still suspended |
| map progress | moved past the item | unchanged (`started: 1, results: []`) |
| item child | still in `listSuspendedRuns()`, orphaned | still suspended and resumable |

Measured before the fix with a scratch test (not committed): `{"res":{"success":true},"after":["one_item:child"],"parentRow":["completed"]}`.

## What changes

- **The resume gate (`refuseGatedResume`, `run-resume.ts`)** walks the linked-run chain once (`resolveSuspensionChain`, which replaces `resolveEffectiveSuspension` and returns every suspension it loaded, the caller's first). Authority is judged first, so an item only its owning service may resume keeps its `PERMISSION_DENIED` (403). Otherwise `refuseMapItemSkip` refuses when the chain holds a `map:` link whose item child is still suspended, naming the item run of the DEEPEST such link, before any state is touched. It refuses whatever the signal carries: a skip is not a question of authority.
- **The engine's own continuations are untouched.** The item's up-bubble goes through `resumeInternal`, never `resume`, so resuming the item run continues the map exactly as before. A `subflow` link is not refused: its signal is delegated to the child.
- **A `map:` link whose item row is gone** (cancelled, or never persisted) is not refused; there is nothing parked to skip. That shape is left as it was.
- **`MAP_ITEM_PENDING_REFUSAL_CODE`** in `run-resume.ts` (module export, not on the package entry) is the one spelling of the code; the refusal and its pins read it.
- **Docblocks:** `LINKED_RUN_PREFIXES`, `resume`, `refuseGatedResume` and the chain walk now state the refusal. Two comments in `degraded-suspended-run-load-log-cause.test.ts` follow the rename.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/service-automation` patch, BREAKING accept-set narrowing, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Open question (asked on the card, not decided here)

No existing code fits a coded 409. `AutomationResult.code` is a closed `packages/spec` union, and the runtime door's `RESUME_REFUSAL_ROWS` maps exactly one resume code to 409: `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS`, documented as a benign concurrent duplicate. The order forbids a `packages/spec` edit, so the code is a placeholder in one constant while the seat's route question (card comment 6514753022, option B: a new code across `packages/spec` + `packages/runtime`) is open. If it is ruled B, the constant, the changeset's `Now.` line and this table's code cell change; nothing else does.

## Tests

`src/map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts` (new, 5):

1. Parent-id resume refused with the code and the item run id; the parent, the map state and the item are unchanged, nothing ran, no `completed` row.
2. Refused even with the owning-service stamp on the signal.
3. Resuming the named item run works and the map continues to completion (two items, parent `completed`, nothing left suspended).
4. A `subflow` parent over a parked `map`: refused at the top id, naming the map's item run.
5. A `subflow` parent-id resume is unchanged (delegated, completes).

`src/resume-authority-gate.test.ts` (changed, 3): "leaves a map over ungated items resumable" pinned the narrowed behaviour and now asserts the refusal. The two map-handoff forgery cases cancel the item first, so the parent's `map:` link has nothing behind it and the `INVALID_SIGNAL` guard is still the answer they pin.

<details><summary>Ablation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs (fix committed first)</summary>

```
ABLATE run-resume.ts  anchor "    for (let i = chain.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {"  x1 -> x0, blob 067d1647 -> 8cef8f91
× refuses with a code naming the item run, and nothing advances
× is refused whatever the signal carries — a skip is not a question of authority
× follows a subflow link down to a map parked on its item, and names that item
× refuses the MAP PARENT over an ungated item too — the item is the door (#27877)
Tests  4 failed | 23 passed (27)
ok restored: blob == HEAD (067d1647d140) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The item-door and `subflow`-unchanged pins stay green under the ablation, as preservation pins should.
</details>

## Verification

- `@objectstack/service-automation` on 7edf37b4: vitest 219 files / 2808 tests green; `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck` green.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on 7edf37b4: 62 derived; 61 exit 0 (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned commit), 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs every package's dist); `--ran` reconcile: 62 accounted, 0 unrun. `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery: owed on the final head (the narrowing arm); reported on the card once it has run.

## Acceptance notes

- The refusal message names the run id only in `error` text; `AutomationResult` has no structured member for it, and adding one is a spec change.
